Turns confirmed AirNudge hand gestures into standard Android navigation gestures. AirNudge does not read screen content.
Point with your index finger to move the pointer. Pinch to tap at its current position.
Control compatible Android apps with deliberate hand gestures. Complete the two setup steps before turning gesture control on.

Privacy\n\nCamera frames are processed locally for hand landmarks. AirNudge does not record, save, or upload frames. The accessibility service performs configured gestures and does not read window content.
Keep one hand visible, use deliberate movements, and return to a neutral pose between actions.

Swipe Up / Down
Move your whole hand vertically.

Swipe Left / Right
Move your whole hand horizontally.

Open Palm
Extend all fingers.

Closed Fist
Fold all fingers toward your palm.

Pinch
Bring the thumb and index fingertip together.

Air Cursor
Extend only the index finger, move it to position the pointer, then pinch to tap.
Good lighting and a hand centered in the preview improve reliability. Small natural movements should not trigger an action. Adjust sensitivity only after trying the Balanced default.
